name: withdraw-money-confirmation
subject: Confirmation of your withdrawal request
previewText: You have requested a withdrawal from your Abundance account

fields.heading: Confirmation of your withdrawal request
fields.body:
Hello {user_first_name},

You have requested the following withdrawal from your Abundance account. This will be transferred to your nominated bank account within one working day.
If you did not make this withdrawal request, please contact us immediately at support@abundanceinvestment.com or 020 3475 8666 so that we can ensure the safety of your account.
